title: Tim Knight Says the Nasdaq Just Broke Its Trend Line and the Dow Took Over
speaker: Tim Knight

macro_themes.view: Not straight down after election day, but markets will get much more chaotic and volatile around it.
VIX shows complete complacency with no fear priced in, so puts are cheap.
A real chance Anthropic delays its November IPO, which would rattle an AI trade that depends on it and OpenAI listing successfully.
Prefers quiet breakdowns beneath the surface; long-term 'death and destruction' remains his view.

calls.reason: NQ broke and has stayed below the trend line from July 29 after failing to follow through on the Oct 6 lifetime high; role change from support to resistance.
calls.quote: we had for the first time punctured this trend line... we have spent the day below the trend line.

calls.reason: ES keeps hugging its horizontal level with no real break.
calls.quote: the ES continues to be a uh uh madly in love with this horizontal. It it really does not stray far from home base

calls.reason: Dow rallying since Oct 2 low, at multi-week highs and broken above a descending channel while tech weakens.
calls.quote: we've cut above this descending channel... the Dow has been the uh the bull haven.

calls.quote: I remain short this with a stop just above that price gap.
